visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a person sitting on a moving ski lift. They are wearing a light blue and black helmet, pink-tinted goggles reflecting the winter landscape, and a black face mask covering everything but their eyes. Their black winter jacket is covered in fresh snow, and they wave a gloved hand toward the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a long shot of an expansive, snow-covered mountain slope during the day. A person in all-black winter gear is seen snowboarding down the wide slope, leaving a trail in the snow. Several other distant figures are visible on the slopes. (3) A POV shot follows, showing the snowboarder's feet and the snowboard as it glides over the white powder. The background consists of snow-laden trees and lift poles. (4) The setting transitions to a night scene on the slopes, illuminated by bright stadium lights. The character is seen snowboarding and then falling onto the soft snow. The background shows the distant lights of a city at night. (5) The final phase returns to a close-up of the character on the ski lift, now significantly more covered in snow on their helmet and jacket, looking exhausted but happy as they talk to the camera.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A ski resort in Hokkaido with wide snowy slopes, coniferous trees covered in frost, ski lift infrastructure, and stadium lighting for night skiing.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Narration begins with a cheerful male voice against a bright acoustic guitar BGM. The speaker has high energy and clear articulation. (2) A noticeable sliding sound of a snowboard on packed snow (high-frequency friction) marks the start of the activity phase. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. (3) The speaker's voice exhibits slight breathiness, indicating physical exertion. Background wind noise and the rhythmic scraping of the snowboard are clearly audible. (4) A percussive thud occurs as the character falls, followed by a brief moment of muffled ambient noise. A second male voice (coach) speaks with a professional and encouraging tone. (5) The narration returns to a close-miked selfie perspective; the acoustic guitar BGM swells slightly as the speaker concludes his thoughts with a satisfied, slightly exhausted vocal delivery.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Personal Experience -> Climax/Failure -> Reflection -> Conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a personal travel and activity vlog documenting a snowboarding trip to Hokkaido. It highlights the joy of experiencing 'powder snow' for the first time, emphasizes the physical toll and persistence required in the sport, and expresses gratitude to the coach/service provider.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video explicitly thanks and tags '@koyuki_ski' for the snowboarding experience and includes text praise for the coach.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A high-energy, well-edited social media vlog that successfully captures the atmospheric 'vibe' of a winter holiday through dynamic cuts and personal storytelling.
